<!-- The title becomes the commit message on main: what the change does,
in the imperative ("show a claim's reach in the viewer"). -->

What it changes, and why:

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] tests cover what the change does (`make coverage` shows the lines)
- [ ] docs and `README.md` updated where a command, flag or the model changed
- [ ] a line in `CHANGELOG.md` where a user sees the change
- [ ] no published paper's text in a test or fixture
